title: Yellowed, Flaky Norwegian Apples Pancake
description: A salty, flaky, energizing Norwegian dish featuring apples and a dairy-free twist.

ingredients.name: 2-3 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dust the skillet or griddle with 2 tablespoons of flour.
Pour 1/4 cup of the pancake batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancake for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancake and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the pancakes are cooked.
Melt the canola oil in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the sliced apples to the melted oil and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Serve the pancakes with the apple mixture and dust with confectioners' sugar.
